question: What additional configurations complete the sacred diagram addressed to the goddess?
premises: An eight-spoked lotus-petaled form is present.
inference: The sacred diagram further includes an eight-spoked lotus-petaled form and a sixteen-plus-one configuration.
uncertainties: The exact referent of ṣoḍaśaikaṃ is ambiguous.
plain_english: O beautiful-faced one, it also has an eight-spoked lotus-petaled form and a sixteen-plus-one configuration.
